Stats

Dwarf_Commoner
Grundlgornn is a dwarven civilian who is listening to  Umbrenne, a prophet of  Talona in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.
“
We've got no choice - we have to do what he says!
„
— Grundlgornn

Involvement

Act Three

Grundlgornn is behind the Stormshore Tabernacle, listening closely to Umbrenne, who is trying to convince him and  Leary Dowse that everyone will die soon thanks to  Talona, otherwise known as the Mistress of Disease. Grundlgornn fully believes him, and proclaims that he does not want to die.

Grundlgornn's attitude towards the party changes depending on the outcome of ⁠Stop the Presses.

Idle banter

  • Leary Dowse
    Talona? You want to let Talona loose in our city?
  • Umbrenne
    Poor, sweet fool - you speak as if the Plague-Crone is not already here, striding among us!
  • Umbrenne
    Her power waxes, and soon the cycle will reach its zenith - should you want it to or otherwise.
  • Leary Dowse
    And then what happens? Nothing good, I bet!
  • Umbrenne
    And then all will perish so the cycle can begin anew!
  • Grundlgornn
    Dear gods, he's right - it's too late to stop it now!
  • Grundlgornn
    What do we do? What can we do?
  • Umbrenne
    Embrace it!
  • Umbrenne
    The Mistress of Disease loves us all - her fondest wish is to free us from the agonies we have created!
  • Grundlgornn
    My lungs feel tight! It's happening already!
  • Leary Dowse
    Oh calm down, would you? It's all in your head.
  • Leary Dowse
    I've a good mind to get the Flaming Fist before people start chucking themselves into the Chionthar.
  • Umbrenne
    All the Talontar await her blessings with open arms - and we pity those who would reject her.
  • Umbrenne
    I will smile as her fevers sear me to my core. I will bask in her febrile radiance.
  • Grundlgornn
    Oh gods, I don't want to die! Not yet!
  • Leary Dowse
    You are not going to die.
  • Umbrenne
    We are all going to die, my friend - some of us merely intend to do so in service of something greater.
  • Umbrenne
    And to thank blessed Talona for the honour.
